title: Web search for research harnesses
requirement: Give the research harnesses a web search provider that needs no paid service and returns usable results for technical queries.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Recall of known-relevant pages for a fixed set of technical queries, rate limiting under ten parallel queries, and setup effort.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
